findings.reason: §5 and §6 each carry an explicit GPFS or `~/.cache/...` output path after the same gap was found there, and §7's gate is per-row, so the row-by-row verdict cannot be checked later if the evidence dies with the job.
findings.text: §7 names only its input receipts (`~/.cache/nova-hessian-diagnosis/`) and no durable path for what it produces: the repaired-kernel trace records at the 64 retained nodes, the rebuilt ITER bank's re-certification receipts, and the per-row base and head results of `tests/biot/test_edge_term_tangents.py` that its third done-when clause requires. A worker can leave all of these in node `/tmp`, which the job removes.

findings.reason: an inert control cannot show the guard fires, and as written it steers the worker toward extending the guard rather than repairing the cancellation the section has just convicted; the control must revert the repair the node makes.
findings.text: §7's negative control (a) is keyed to one implementation ("restoring the corner-height-only guard must fail the new edge-line regression test"), while the section's own root cause places the fault in the projected-offset plane denominator formed in `_Edge.__init__` and consumed by `_Edge.terms`. A repair made in that denominator leaves the corner guard untouched, so restoring the guard would not revert the repair and the control would pass without distinguishing a repaired kernel from an unrepaired one.

findings.reason: the in-plan waits now file §7 ahead of §2 and §3 (§7's own declarations), but the reciprocal cross-plan wait is prose only, so either of kernel-compile-barrier's §6 repair or §2 ordered-sharing can be dispatched against the unrepaired kernel and its own repair re-based on a tangent about to change; §7 needed to declare its cross-plan waits itself.
findings.text: §7 states "kernel-compile-barrier ... Its §6 repair waits on this section's node (a), and its §2 ordered-sharing node restructures the same height-sample code", but `kernel-compile-barrier.html` carries no `plan-section-depends-on` metadata at all, so nothing records or posts the link from §7 to that plan's section §6 or §2.
